rules.name: Requirements Overview
rules.desc:
A PhD minor is a program outside a major department. The minor department establishes requirements for a minor. The major department determines the acceptance of the minor as part of the total PhD program. Application for the PhD minor must be approved by both the major and the minor department.
A student desiring a PhD minor in Civil and Environmental Engineering (CEE) must have a minor program advisor who is both a CEE faculty member and a member of the Academic Council. The faculty member must be in the program of the designated minor subfield of CEE. The advisor must be a member of the student's University Oral Examination committee and the reading committee for the doctoral dissertation.
The program must include at least 20 graduate-level coursework units (courses numbered 200 or above, excluding special studies and thesis) in CEE completed at Stanford University. The list of courses must form a coherent program and must be approved by the minor program advisor and the CEE chair. A minimum GPA of 3.0 must be achieved in these courses.
